- `app-api` 提供登录/当前权限、项目/看板/需求/任务查询，需求保存与拆解批次、任务创建与 patch 依赖调整；调用现有 `service/identity`、`service/business`、`service/delivery`。

- 新增 Push 订阅表迁移与运行配置说明。

```text
cd server && go test -count=1 ./common/objectstore ./service/delivery/... && go build ./common/objectstore ./service/delivery/... && go vet ./common/objectstore ./service/delivery/...
```
